observed_evidence: NO. Every one of the 28 config/model combinations has policy macro Dice BELOW GLOBAL (28/28). The most aggressive policy (R1-C5) still trails GLOBAL by -0.131136 (UNet), -0.143855 (Attention U-Net), -0.157948 (UNet++) and -0.133755 (DeepLabV3+). Selectivity sharply reduces the FP burden (mean FP delta falls from +7778 to about +2049, a 74% reduction) and roughly halves the Dice deficit, but the burden remains POSITIVE for every policy and the deficit is never closed. Case worsening is essentially unchanged: 93.0-94.5 of 103 cases worsen under every policy.
limitations: No post-hoc cutoff applied; all 28 config/model combinations remain below GLOBAL; case worsening unchanged at 93.0-94.5 of 103.

observed_evidence: PARTIALLY, AND NOT SUFFICIENTLY. Component losses are 0 for every policy and every architecture, and empty recoveries are largely retained (C0 8/3/5/11 vs C5 8/3/5/10). But component recoveries collapse under aggressive selectivity: 16/9/14/16 at C0 (55 total) down to 2/1/3/4 at C1 and C5 (10 total) - an 82% loss of the recovery signal. RETENTION_DICE is negative for ALL 28 config/model combinations, so no policy converts the oracle mechanism into positive deployable benefit.
limitations: RETENTION_DICE negative in 28/28; recovery collapse is measured, not inferred; component losses 0 are preserved as genuine favourable evidence.

observed_evidence: YES - this is the dimension H1 clearly improves. Accepted proposals fall 494 -> 102 (C0 -> C5), GT-miss accepted proposals fall 372 -> 68, mean accepted proposals per image fall 4.796 -> 0.990, and mean intervention union area falls 0.004846 -> 0.001486. Mean policy precision rises from 0.2342 to 0.4259 while mean recall is essentially unchanged (0.6664 -> 0.6502). Selectivity therefore does improve intervention precision. However the accepted GT-miss FRACTION remains 0.666667 (68/102) versus 0.753036 (372/494) at C0 - a real improvement, but two thirds of the surviving interventions are still off-target.
limitations: GT fields are post-freeze descriptive only; membership was label-blind; accepted GT-miss fraction 0.666667 remains high.

observed_evidence: GENERAL, NOT ARCHITECTURE-SPECIFIC. The negative Dice-vs-GLOBAL behaviour holds in all four architectures for every policy (28/28 below GLOBAL). At R1-C5, cases worse in all four = 84 of 103, components recovered by >=1 architecture = 6, recovered by all four = 1, and components lost by >=1 architecture = 0. The mitigation is also consistent: every architecture improves under aggressive selectivity and loses recovery at the same time. No architecture is a winner, no ranking is made.
limitations: No winner and no ranking; the negative result is general, so no architecture-specific rescue is available.
